# Floor & Decor Expands Florida Presence With New Melbourne Store


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_3e9b4774cad2466a1906c3dc44eaffd6/flooranddecor/news/2026-10-22_Floor_Decor_Expands_Florida_Presence_With_New_308.pdf) October 22, 2026 8:35am EDT


*— Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring brings its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to the Space Coast —*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its newest Florida warehouse store and design center in Melbourne at 1725 Columbia Lane.


The Melbourne store opens with a team of approximately 45 associates led by Jessica Walker, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


The new store gives Space Coast homeowners and professionals local access to a broad assortment of in-stock tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone options, including waterproof styles suited to Florida living, along with installation materials, decorative accessories and related categories at everyday low prices.


“We’re proud to bring Floor & Decor to Melbourne,” said Walker. “This new store reflects our continued commitment to providing homeowners and professionals with great products, expert guidance, and strong value, all in one place. We can’t wait to connect with the community and be a trusted resource for their home projects.”


The new Melbourne store opens to customers today, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony to follow on Thursday, October 29, and an official grand opening celebration on Saturday, November 7.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony**


Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, October 29, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Space Coast Chamber of Commerce.


**Grand Opening Celebration**


On Saturday, November 7, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. ET, the store will host a Block Party for the Melbourne community, featuring prize drawings every 15 minutes, giveaways from local businesses, a complimentary lunch from local food trucks, and family-friendly activities.


**Store Facts & Features**


- Location: 1725 Columbia Lane, Melbourne, FL 32904
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (321) 491-6077


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.**


Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
